title: Your only limit is your imagination when creating with Ai...
author: Maidforblood
selftext:
As the title suggests, you are limited to literally anything. As long as nothing breaks your ai tool guide line rules or policy,  do keep in mind that whatever you are creating with ai, always check how much ai tokens you are using. We are somewhat limited to tokens, and some things that are allowed and not allowed \*for obvious reasons\* if you have an idea, make it with ai. Plan with it, and see how it goes from there with your projects, if the project is too big, create pieces of it first then piece them together one at a time.  Also one shotting prompts will sometimes create bugs here and there. Most people dont realise this but when working with ai, you are the director, you create vision and plan what specifics needs to be done. Dont be afraid to try them.  If something doesnt work. Try a different way, experiment. Learn what things to try out before being happy with the end result.

what is your imagination? What did you want to create? What ideas would be awesome to showcase to the world?
